history: Two extensively reused Bundesliga matches; all020 follows019 development; no independent test.
sources: Existing first-division IDSSE/Sportec CC BY4.0; provider BallStatus/Possession supervision only
emissions: Frozen019 in each opposite-match training fold; RNN, H/A correction and dead experts unchanged
training_conditions: same as018/019; unchanged masks and tracker-noise seeds
head: L2 multinomial logistic2-class,25epochs,seed120,l2=.001; train-match-only standardisation and fit
sampling: every5th valid live-neighbourhood frame; randomly downsample negatives to positives per half/condition; event scores not naturally calibrated probabilities
target: Direct known H/A turnover within+-12frames; only entirely known-live neighbourhoods valid; D changes excluded
features: team-invariant existing geometry/interaction/boundary features plus pooled absolute H/A probability changes at+-12/25/50frames; no labels or timestamps
decoder: Only H/A transition cost adapts; stop/restart cost3 fixed; no hard duration floor
selection: Best four-condition meanF1 passing no aggregate misses/merges/FP increase; each clean/ball-gap fold no F1 loss>.01; each tracker-noise fold no loss; deadF1 loss<=.005 each fold/condition. No post-result retuning.
